description: This file defines a Java interface named 'EntityIdWithRevision' that models an entity identifier coupled with a revision number. It includes method declarations to retrieve the entity ID and revision, as well as a default method to generate a combined identifier string. The interface also contains a nested final class defining JSON field constants for serialization purposes.

classes.name: EntityIdWithRevision
classes.description: An interface representing the ID of an entity along with its revision, enabling JSON serialization and providing methods to access the entity ID, revision number, and a formatted identifier string.

classes.name: EntityIdWithRevision.JsonFields
classes.description: A nested final class containing JSON field definitions for 'id' and 'revision' used during serialization.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the Entity ID of the modified entity.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the modified entity.

methods.name: asIdentifierString
methods.description: Returns a string combining the entity ID and revision in the format '<id>:<revision>'.
